title.narrative: UNICEF vaccinated over 737,000 previously unvaccinated children, introduced pneumococcal and rotavirus vaccines, and achieved 70 percent coverage for essential immunizations. By strengthening routine immunization systems, expanding services in hard-to-reach areas, and improving data quality, Somalia advanced toward sustainable immunization delivery, protecting millions of children from preventable diseases.
